title: Nexus default view (dashboard/views/<view>.yaml)
description: The repository-provided default layout: where contributed components sit on the canvas and the initial viewport. Versioned with the persona repository. Operator edits never touch this file - they live in a local overlay on the control-plane host, patched over this default at render time. A node ref naming an unknown component is a compile error.

apiVersion.description: Pins the view contract this document was written against; only this exact value is admitted.

kind.description: Marks the document as a Nexus view layout, distinguishing it from a NexusContribution file.

id.description: View identity; the file is conventionally named <id>.yaml. `default` is the view the canvas opens with.

title.description: Display name of the view; the canvas falls back to a default name when omitted.

spec.description: The layout itself: node placements and the initial viewport.

nodes.description: Placements of contributed components, people and groups on the canvas.

ref.description: A component, person or group id from the repository's contributions.

position.description: Where the node sits on the canvas.

x.description: Horizontal canvas coordinate of the node.

y.description: Vertical canvas coordinate of the node.

parent.description: Group id this node is placed inside.

viewport.description: The pan and zoom the canvas opens with. When omitted, the canvas opens fitted to the whole map.

x.description: Horizontal pan offset of the initial viewport.

y.description: Vertical pan offset of the initial viewport.

zoom.description: Initial zoom factor; 1 renders the canvas unscaled.
